```{r user-settings}
# =========================
# User settings
# =========================

# Your xlsx should contain three columns:
# model name, Delta LOOIC, and model family.
input_xlsx <- params$input_xlsx
sheet <- params$sheet
fig_dir <- params$fig_dir
fig_name <- params$fig_name

# Column names in your xlsx sheet.
# Edit these three names to match your actual df columns after read_xlsx().
model_col <- "model"
delta_looic_col <- "delta_looic"
family_col <- "family"

# Font sizes.
axis_title_x_size <- 60
axis_title_y_size <- 60
axis_text_x_size <- 60
axis_text_y_size <- 60
legend_title_size <- 46
legend_text_size <- 46
bar_label_size <- 16

# Figure size.
fig_width <- 20
fig_height <- 20
# Optional: manually define colors for your five model families.
# Keep the names exactly the same as the family names in your xlsx.
# If a family is not listed here, the script will assign a default color.
family_colors_manual <- c(
  # "Family 1" = "#E76F51",
  # "Family 2" = "#F4A261",
  # "Family 3" = "#2A9D8F",
  # "Family 4" = "#457B9D",
  # "Family 5" = "#8A5A9E"
)

default_family_palette <- c(
  "#E76F51",
  "#F4A261",
  "#2A9D8F",
  "#457B9D",
  "#8A5A9E",
  "#6C757D",
  "#B56576",
  "#7F5539"
)

default_family_palette <- c(
  "#4E79A7",  # muted blue
  "#F28E2B",  # orange
  "#59A14F",  # green
  "#E15759",  # red
  "#B07AA1",  # purple
  "#76B7B2",  # teal
  "#EDC948",  # yellow
  "#9C755F"   # brown
)

default_family_palette <- c(
  "#8FB7D9",  # soft blue
  "#F2B880",  # soft orange

  "#E99A9A",  # soft red

```

```{r read-and-clean-data}
if (!file.exists(input_xlsx)) {
  stop("Cannot find input xlsx file: ", input_xlsx)
}

df <- readxl::read_xlsx(input_xlsx, sheet = sheet)

required_cols <- c(model_col, delta_looic_col, family_col)
missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(df))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "These required columns were not found in df: ",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
    "\nAvailable columns are: ",
    paste(names(df), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

model_data <- df %>%
  select(
    model = all_of(model_col),
    delta_looic = all_of(delta_looic_col),
    family = all_of(family_col)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    model = as.character(model),
    delta_looic = as.numeric(delta_looic),
    family = as.character(family)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(model), !is.na(delta_looic), !is.na(family))

family_levels <- model_data %>%
  distinct(family) %>%
  pull(family)

auto_family_colors <- setNames(
  grDevices::colorRampPalette(default_family_palette)(length(family_levels)),
  family_levels
)

family_colors <- auto_family_colors
family_colors[names(family_colors_manual)] <- family_colors_manual

model_order <- c(
  "M1-1", "M1-2", "M1-3",
  "M2-1", "M2-2",
  "M3-1", "M3-2", "M3-3", "M3-4", "M3-5", "M3-6", 
  "M4-1", "M4-2",
  "M5-1" 
)

model_data <- model_data %>%
  mutate(
    family = factor(family, levels = family_levels),
    model = factor(model, levels = rev(model_order))
  )

model_data
```

```{r plot-model-comparison}


family_rename <- c(
  "Family1" = "F1-PE-based evaluation",
  "Family2" = "F2-Intrinsic bias model",
  "Family3" = "F3-PE-based evaluation with intrinsic bias",
  "Family4" = "F4-Outcome-based evaluation",
  "Family5" = "F5-Intention-based evaluation"
)

model_data <- model_data %>%
  mutate(
    family = dplyr::recode(family, !!!family_rename)
)

family_levels <- model_data %>%
  distinct(family) %>%
  pull(family)

auto_family_colors <- setNames(
  grDevices::colorRampPalette(default_family_palette)(length(family_levels)),
  family_levels
)

family_colors <- auto_family_colors


if (!dir.exists(fig_dir)) {
  dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

p_model_comparison <- ggplot(
  model_data,
  aes(x = model, y = delta_looic, fill = family)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "black", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = number(delta_looic, accuracy = 0.1)),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = bar_label_size
  ) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = family_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))
  ) +
  xlab("Model") +
  ylab(expression(Delta * "LOOIC")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = axis_title_x_size, margin = margin(t = 20)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = axis_title_y_size, margin = margin(r = 20)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = axis_text_x_size, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 20)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = axis_text_y_size, color = "black", margin = margin(r = 20)),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.9),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 16, r = 16, b = 16, l = 16),
    
    legend.position = c(0.62, 0.35),
    legend.justification = c(0.5, 0.5),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.75), color = NA),
    legend.title = element_text(size = legend_title_size, margin = margin(b = 16)),
    legend.text = element_text(size = legend_text_size),
    legend.key.height = unit(1.2, "cm"),
    legend.key.spacing.y = unit(0.4, "cm")
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Model family"))

p_model_comparison

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, paste0(fig_name, ".svg")),
  plot = p_model_comparison,
  width = fig_width,
  height = fig_height,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, paste0(fig_name, ".png")),
  plot = p_model_comparison,
  width = fig_width,
  height = fig_height,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600
)
```

```{r save-processed-table}
write.csv(
  model_data,
  file = file.path(fig_dir, paste0(fig_name, "_processed_data.csv")),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
